svg.text: Gathered by hand from the hedgerows of the
Blackwater Valley at Killavullen, in a rare year of
abundance. Hawthorn — the lone ‘fairy tree’ of
Irish folklore — steeped slowly in raw cider vinegar
for a bright, floral and gently tannic finish.
Brighten dressings and marinades, deglaze a pan,
finish roast roots or game, or add a splash to
sparkling water for a refreshing drink.
Irish cider vinegar, wild hawthorn berries ([X]%).
None declared — confirm vinegar is sulphite-free.
Cool, dark place; sediment may form — shake before use.
Design mockup · final print uses Fraunces + Space Grotesk · [bracketed] values to confirm before printing · approx. 55 × 80 mm on a 100 ml bottle
